column4: Enforce role-based authorization on every new endpoint

column4: Fix AgentCreditService retry-exhaustion handling under concurrent bookings
column16: Found 2026-08-30 verifying B1: catch clause `catch (DbUpdateConcurrencyException) when (attempt < MaxRetries)` in AgentCreditService.cs:72 lets the exception propagate uncaught on the final retry instead of the intended graceful decline at line 79 (dead code as written). Fails safe (no overspend) but a real booking under real contention gets a 500. Sits directly in Module 5's payment path, must land before E4e is considered done. DONE 2026-09-24: debits now serialised with a row lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) so contention yields approve/decline, never an error; retry exhaustion returns a declined result; a retry no longer detaches the caller's tracked booking (ChangeTracker.Clear() bug found on the way). Tests: exact 10-of-15 approvals, forced-conflict exhaustion, tracked booking survives a retry.
